relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2, although driven by prohypertrophic signals, exerted broad autocrine antihypertrophic effects.

relationships.subject: TGF-beta1
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 release, which rose in the first three weeks of MSC chondrogenesis, was jointly stimulated by endogenous BMP, WNT, and hedgehog activity that supported the exogenous stimulation by TGF-β1 and insulin

key_findings: MSC-derived PGE2 is driven by BMP, WNT, hedgehog and TGF-beta1 and exerts autocrine antihypertrophic, chondroprotective effects.
